compatible.executable_observation: The gzip-selection wrapper delegates both compressed and fallback responses to Flask send_from_directory, preserving the pinned safe-join containment boundary.
compatible.subject: Minimize and compress JS bundles size (#486)

focal_property: For Aim's /static-files/<path> procedure, a request-controlled asset name cannot cause the response to select a file outside the configured UI build directory, including when the procedure selects a gzip-compressed variant.

invalidated.executable_observation: The FastAPI migration joins caller-controlled path text to the packaged UI root and passes the result directly to FileResponse; relative traversal and absolute input can select filesystem targets outside that root.
invalidated.subject: Set up initial backend structure with FastAPI (#496)

source.executable_observation: The source Flask static-file endpoint delegates the caller-supplied relative path to Flask send_from_directory with a separately constructed packaged UI root.
source.subject: Move the Flask server to main repo to support 'docker'less UI (#455)
